paragraphs: ACNB Corporation, headquartered in Gettysburg, Pennsylvania, is the financial holding company for the wholly-owned subsidiaries of ACNB Bank, Gettysburg, Pennsylvania, and ACNB Insurance Services, Westminster, Maryland. Originally founded in 1857, ACNB Bank serves its marketplace with banking, mortgage and wealth management services, including trust and retail brokerage, via a network of 33 community banking offices and two loan offices located in the Pennsylvania counties of Adams, Berks, Cumberland, Franklin, Lancaster and York and the Maryland counties of Baltimore, Carroll and Frederick. ACNB Insurance Services, the Corporation's insurance subsidiary, is a full-service agency licensed to do business in 46 states. The agency offers a broad range of property, casualty, health, life and disability insurance serving personal and commercial clients through office locations in Westminster, Maryland, and Gettysburg, Pennsylvania.

ACNB Corporation was formed in 1982, and became the bank holding company for ACNB Bank (formerly Adams County National Bank) in 1983. On July 1, 2017, ACNB Corporation completed the acquisition of New Windsor Bancorp, Inc. and its wholly-owned subsidiary, New Windsor State Bank, a Maryland state-chartered, FDIC-insured community bank headquartered in Taneytown, Maryland. On January 11, 2020, ACNB completed its acquisition of Frederick County Bancorp, Inc. and its wholly-owned subsidiary, Frederick County Bank, a Maryland state-chartered, FDIC-insured community bank headquartered in Frederick, Maryland. Effective February 1, 2025, ACNB closed the acquisition of Traditions Bancorp, Inc., holding company for Traditions Bank, York, Pennsylvania. Traditions was merged with and into a wholly-owned subsidiary of ACNB Corporation immediately followed by the merger of Traditions Bank with and into ACNB Bank. ACNB Bank is operating the former Traditions Bank offices as "Traditions Bank, A Division of ACNB Bank". Traditions Bank operated eight community banking offices in South Central Pennsylvania which were included in the Acquisition. In April 2025, ACNB consolidated two of the eight Traditions Bank offices into nearby ACNB Bank offices.

The Corporation purchased its insurance subsidiary, ACNB Insurance Services (formerly Russell Insurance Group, Inc.) in 2005. On February 28, 2022, ACNB Insurance Services, completed the acquisition of the business and assets of Hockley & O'Donnell, located in Gettysburg, Pennsylvania.

ACNB's major source of unconsolidated operating funds is dividends that it receives from its subsidiaries. ACNB's unconsolidated expenses consist principally of interest expense on long-term borrowings and general expenses related to corporate governance. Dividends that ACNB pays to stockholders consist primarily of dividends declared and paid to ACNB by its subsidiary bank, ACNB Bank.

ACNB and its subsidiaries are not dependent upon a single customer or a small number of customers, the loss of which would have a material adverse effect on the Corporation. ACNB does not depend on foreign sources of funds, nor does it make foreign loans.
The common stock of ACNB is listed on The NASDAQ Capital Market under the symbol ACNB. BANKING SUBSIDIARY

ACNB Bank is a full-service commercial bank operating under charter from the Pennsylvania Department of Banking and Securities. The Bank's principal Market Areas include Adams County, Pennsylvania, and its surrounding areas in South-central Pennsylvania, as well as Carroll and Frederick Counties in Northern Maryland. This geographic area depends on agriculture, industry, tourism, education and healthcare, as well as local governments, to provide employment for its residents. No single sector dominates the area's economy. At December 31, 2025, ACNB Bank had total assets of $3.21 billion, total loans, net of unearned income, of $2.33 billion, total deposits of $2.48 billion, and total equity capital of $398.3 million. In October 2010, the Bank converted from a national banking association to a Pennsylvania state-chartered bank and trust company.

The main community banking office of the Bank is located at 16 Lincoln Square, Gettysburg, Pennsylvania. The Bank has a total of 33 community banking offices. The Bank serves its local marketplace in Pennsylvania through 24 community banking offices, including 10 offices in Adams County, nine offices in York County, one office in Cumberland County, one in Franklin County, and two offices and a limited-service office in Lancaster County. In Maryland the Bank serves its local marketplace via a network of nine community banking offices including five located in Carroll County and four located in Frederick County. There are loan production offices located in West Lawn, Pennsylvania and Hunt Valley, Maryland. The Bank's service delivery channels for its customers also include the ATM network, Customer Contact Center, and Online, Telephone and Mobile Banking. The Bank is subject to regulation and periodic examination by the Pennsylvania Department of Banking and Securities and the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation. The FDIC, as provided by law, insures the Bank's deposits.

Commercial lending includes commercial mortgages, real estate development and construction loans, accounts receivable and inventory financing, and agricultural and governmental loans. Consumer lending programs include home equity loans and lines of credit, automobile and recreational vehicle loans, manufactured housing loans, and personal lines of credit. Mortgage lending is done through Traditions Mortgage, a division of ACNB Bank, and includes programs such as personal residential mortgages, residential construction loans, and investment mortgage loans.

The Bank, through its trust and investment services group, under the umbrella of ACNB Wealth Management, is named as trustee of financial assets. A trust is a legal fiduciary agreement whereby as trustee, the Bank invests, protects, manages and distributes financial assets as defined in the agreement. Estate settlement governed by the last will and testament of an individual constitutes another line of business for ACNB Wealth Management. Other services include, but are not limited to, those related to testamentary trusts, life insurance trusts, charitable remainder trusts, guardianships, powers of attorney, custodial accounts, and investment management and advisory accounts. Total trust assets under management and administration were $444.8 million and $24.1 million, respectively at December 31, 2025.

The Bank, through the wealth advisory services group, also under the umbrella of ACNB Wealth Management, offers retail brokerage services through a third-party provider. This third-party provider is a broker/dealer, unaffiliated with the Bank or ACNB Wealth Management. At December 31, 2025, total assets under management and administration with the broker/dealer were $238.3 million and $31.6 million, respectively.
NONBANKING SUBSIDIARY ACNB Insurance Services

ACNB Corporation's wholly-owned subsidiary, ACNB Insurance Services, is a full-service insurance agency, licensed to do business in 46 states that offers a broad range of property, casualty, health, life and disability insurance to both commercial and individual clients. Based in Westminster, Maryland, ACNB Insurance Services, has served the needs of its clients since its founding as an independent insurance agency by Frank C. Russell, Jr. in 1978. The agency was purchased by the Corporation in 2005. ACNB Insurance Services operates an additional location in Gettysburg, Pennsylvania. Total assets of ACNB Insurance Services as of December 31, 2025, were $19.7 million.

ACNB Insurance Services is managed separately from the Bank and is reported as a separate operating segment. Financial information on this segment is included in Note 22 — "Segment and Related Information" in the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements under Part II, Item 8 — "Financial Statements and Supplementary Data".

ACNB's earnings and cash flows are largely dependent upon its net interest income. Net interest income is the difference between interest income earned on interest-earning assets, such as loans and securities, and interest expense paid on interest-bearing liabilities, such as deposits and borrowed funds. Interest rates are highly sensitive to many factors that are beyond ACNB's control, including general economic conditions and policies of various governmental and regulatory agencies and, in particular, the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System. Changes in monetary policy, including changes in interest rates, could influence not only the amount of interest ACNB receives on loans and securities and the amount of interest it pays on deposits and borrowings, but such changes could also affect (i) ACNB's ability to originate loans and obtain deposits, (ii) the fair value of ACNB's financial assets and liabilities, and (iii) the average duration of ACNB's mortgage-backed securities portfolio. If the interest rates paid on deposits and other borrowings increase at a faster rate than the interest rates received on loans and other investments, ACNB's net interest income, and therefore earnings, could be adversely affected. Earnings could also be adversely affected if the interest rates received on loans and other investments fall more quickly than the interest rates paid on deposits and other borrowings.

Although management believes it has implemented effective asset and liability management strategies to reduce the potential effects of changes and volatility in interest rates on ACNB's results of operations, any substantial, unexpected or prolonged change in market interest rates could have a material adverse effect on ACNB's financial condition and results of operations.

As of December 31, 2025, approximately 68% of ACNB's loan portfolio consisted of commercial real estate loans, commercial and industrial and construction. These types of loans are generally viewed as having more risk of default than residential real estate loans or consumer loans. These types of loans are also typically larger than residential real estate loans and consumer loans. Because ACNB's loan portfolio contains a significant number of commercial real estate, commercial and industrial and construction loans with relatively large balances, the deterioration of one or a few of these loans could cause a significant increase in non-performing loans. An increase in non-performing loans could result in a net loss of earnings from these loans, an increase in the provision for credit losses, and an increase in loan charge-offs, all of which could have a material adverse effect on ACNB's financial condition and results of operations.
ACNB IS ALSO SUBJECT TO COMMERCIAL REAL ESTATE VOLATILITY.

The commercial real estate market nationally, regionally, and locally has recently been subject to increased levels of volatility. Many believe that commercial real estate in the commercial office sector is undergoing a fundamental transformation and change that started during the recent pandemic but also continues due to evolving workplace environments. These changes in the marketplace affect the demand for commercial office space which in turn may affect the credit status, profitability, and collectability, of existing and future commercial real estate office sector loans. As explained above in greater detail in the risk factor for Credit Risk, volatility and increases in non-performing loans could have an adverse impact on ACNB's financial condition and results of operations.
ACNB'S ALLOWANCE FOR CREDIT LOSSES MAY BE INSUFFICIENT.

paragraphs: ACNB Corporation,總部設於賓夕法尼亞州蓋茨堡, 是ACNB Bank, 賓夕法尼亞州蓋茨堡, 以及ACNB Insurance Services, 馬裏蘭州韋斯敏斯特的 wholly-owned 子公司的財務控股公司。原於1857年成立, ACNB Bank透過位於賓夕法尼亞州亞當斯、伯克斯、卡姆布里亞、弗蘭克林、蘭開斯特與約克縣, 以及馬裏蘭州巴爾的摩、卡羅爾與弗雷德裏克縣的33間社區銀行分行與兩間貸款分行, 提供銀行、房貸與財富管理服務, 包括信託與零售證券業務。ACNB Insurance Services, 本公司之保險子公司, 是經許可可在46州營運的全服務代理機構。該代理機構提供廣泛的財產、意外、健康、壽險與傷殘保險, 服務個人與商業客戶, 透過位於馬裏蘭州韋斯敏斯特與賓夕法尼亞州蓋茨堡的辦公室。

ACNB Corporation於1982年成立, 並於1983年成為ACNB Bank (原為亞當斯縣國家銀行) 的銀行控股公司。2017年7月1日, ACNB Corporation完成對New Windsor Bancorp, Inc.及其 wholly-owned 子公司New Windsor State Bank的收購, 這是一家馬裏蘭州州立發行、FDIC保險的社區銀行, 總部設於馬裏蘭州坦尼鎮。2020年1月11日, ACNB完成對Frederick County Bancorp, Inc.及其 wholly-owned 子公司Frederick County Bank的收購, 這是一家馬裏蘭州州立發行、FDIC保險的社區銀行, 總部設於馬裏蘭州弗雷德裏克。自2025年2月1日起, ACNB完成對Traditions Bancorp, Inc.的收購, 這是一家位於賓夕法尼亞州約克的Traditions Bank的控股公司。Traditions被合併至ACNB Corporation的 wholly-owned 子公司, 隨即Traditions Bank與ACNB Bank合併。ACNB Bank目前以"Traditions Bank, A Division of ACNB Bank"的名義運作前Traditions Bank的分行。Traditions Bank在南中央賓夕法尼亞州運作八間社區銀行分行, 這些分行包含在收購中。2025年4月, ACNB將Traditions Bank的兩間分行合併至附近的ACNB Bank分行。
本公司於2005年購入其保險子公司ACNB Insurance Services (原為Russell Insurance Group, Inc.)。2022年2月28日, ACNB Insurance Services完成對位於賓夕法尼亞州蓋茨堡的Hockley & O'Donnell業務與資產的收購。
ACNB未合併營運資金的主要來源為其子公司所支付的股息。ACNB未合併營運費用主要為長期借款的利息支出及與公司治理相關的總體費用。ACNB支付給股東的股息主要為其子公司銀行ACNB Bank所宣告並支付的股息。
ACNB及其子公司不依賴單一客戶或少數客戶, 這些客戶的流失不會對本公司造成重大不利影響。ACNB不依賴外國資金來源, 也不進行外國貸款。
ACNB的普通股於NASDAQ Capital Market上市, 代碼為ACNB。BANKING SUBSIDIARY

ACNB Bank 是一家提供全方位商業銀行服務的銀行，根據賓夕法尼亞州銀行與證券部的章程運作。該銀行的主要營運區域包括賓夕法尼亞州亞當斯縣及其南中部賓夕法尼亞州周邊地區，以及馬裏蘭州北方的卡羅爾縣與弗雷德裏克縣。此地理區域依賴農業、工業、旅遊、教育與醫療保健，以及地方政府，為其居民提供就業機會。沒有任何單一產業主導該地區的經濟。於 2025 年 12 月 31 日，ACNB Bank 的總資產為 3.21 十億美元，總貸款額（扣除未實現收入）為 2.33 十億美元，總存款為 2.48 十億美元，以及總權益資本為 398.3 百萬美元。於 2010 年 10 月，該銀行從國家銀行協會轉型為賓夕法尼亞州立案的銀行與信託公司。

該銀行的主要社區銀行分行位於賓夕法尼亞州蓋茨堡的16 Lincoln Square。該銀行總共有33間社區銀行分行。該銀行透過24間社區銀行分行服務賓夕法尼亞州的本地市場, 包括亞當斯縣的10間分行、約克縣的9間分行、卡姆布里亞縣的1間分行、弗蘭克林縣的1間分行, 以及蘭開斯特縣的2間分行與1間有限服務分行。在馬裏蘭州, 該銀行透過9間社區銀行分行服務本地市場, 包括卡羅爾縣的5間分行與弗雷德裏克縣的4間分行。貸款業務分行位於賓夕法尼亞州西蘭與馬裏蘭州漢特維爾。該銀行的服務交付渠道也包括ATM網路、客戶聯絡中心, 以及線上、電話與行動銀行服務。該銀行受賓夕法尼亞州銀行與證券部與美國存款保險公司(FDIC)的監管與定期檢查。根據法律, FDIC保險該銀行的存款。
商業貸款包括商業房貸、不動產開發與建築貸款、應收帳款與存貨融資，以及農業與政府貸款。消費貸款方案包括房屋貸款與信用線、汽車與休閒車貸款、製造住宅貸款，以及個人信用線。房貸貸款透過Traditions Mortgage，為ACNB Bank的分公司，並包含個人住宅房貸、住宅建築貸款與投資房貸貸款等方案。

本公司透過其信託與投資服務部門，隸屬於ACNB Wealth Management之下，被指定為財務資產的受託人。信託是一種法律上的信託契約，作為受託人，本公司投資、保護、管理並分配根據契約所定義的財務資產。根據個人最後遺囑進行遺產處理，構成ACNB Wealth Management的另一項業務。其他服務包括，但不限於與遺囑信託、人壽保險信託、慈善餘值信託、監護權、授權書、保管帳戶及投資管理與顧問帳戶相關的服務。截至2025年12月31日，總信託資產規模為444.8 百萬美元及24.1 百萬美元。
銀行透過財富諮詢服務部門，同樣在ACNB Wealth Management的框架下，也提供零售證券交易服務，透過第三方機構進行。此第三方機構為經紀商/經銷商，與銀行或ACNB Wealth Management無關聯。截至2025年12月31日，與經紀商/經銷商管理與行政的總資產分別為238.3 百萬美元與31.6 百萬美元。
非銀行子公司ACNB Insurance Services

ACNB Corporation的 wholly-owned subsidiary，ACNB Insurance Services，為一家全服務保險經紀公司，經許可可在46個州營業，為商業與個人客戶提供廣泛的財產、意外、健康、人壽與傷殘保險。ACNB Insurance Services設立於馬裏蘭州威明頓市，自1978年由Frank C. Russell, Jr.創立為獨立保險經紀公司以來，一直服務客戶。該經紀公司於2005年被該公司收購。ACNB Insurance Services在賓夕法尼亞州葛迪斯堡市設有另一個據點。截至2025年12月31日，ACNB Insurance Services的總資產為19.7 百萬美元。
ACNB Insurance Services與銀行分開管理，並被報告為獨立的運營部門。此部門的財務資訊包含在附註22 — "部門及相關資訊"中，位於財務報表與補充資料的第二部分，項目8 — "財務報表與補充資料"。

ACNB 的獲利與現金流 largely dependent 於其淨利息收入。淨利息收入為利息收入與利息支出的差額，其中利息收入來自於利息產生資產（如貸款與證券），利息支出則來自於利息負債（如存款與借入資金）。利率對許多因素極為敏感，而這些因素超出 ACNB 的控制範圍，包括總體經濟狀況與各政府與監管機構的政策，特別是聯邦儲備系統理事會的政策。貨幣政策的變化，包括利率的變化，不僅會影響 ACNB 從貸款與證券所獲得的利息，以及支付存款與借入資金的利息，也可能影響 (i) ACNB 創造貸款與取得存款的能力，(ii) ACNB 金融資產與負債的公允價值，以及 (iii) ACNB 按揭證券投資組合的平均存續期間。如果存款與其他借入資金的利率增加速度高於貸款與其他投資的利率，ACNB 的淨利息收入，以及因此獲利，可能會受到不利影響。獲利也可能受到不利影響，如果貸款與其他投資所收到的利率下降速度高於存款與其他借入資金的利率。
儘管管理階層認為已實施有效的資產與負債管理策略，以降低利率變動與波動對 ACNB 營運成果的潛在影響，但任何重大、意外或持續的市場利率變動，都可能對 ACNB 的財務狀況與營運成果造成重大不利影響。

截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，約 68% 的 ACNB 貸款組合為商業不動產貸款、商業與工業及建設貸款。這類貸款通常被視為比起住宅不動產貸款或消費貸款具有更高的違約風險。這類貸款通常也比住宅不動產貸款及消費貸款規模更大。由於 ACNB 的貸款組合包含大量商業不動產、商業與工業及建設貸款，且單筆貸款金額相對較大，因此若其中一筆或多筆貸款惡化，可能會導致非 Performing 貸款顯著增加。非 Performing 貸款增加可能會導致這些貸款的獲利淨損失增加、信貸損失提列準備金增加，以及貸款核銷增加，所有這些都可能對 ACNB 的財務狀況與營運成果造成重大不利影響。
ACNB 也會受到商業不動產波動的影響。

全國、地區及地方的商業不動產市場近期經歷了更高程度的波動。許多人認為商業不動產在商業辦公室部門正經歷一項根本性的轉變與變化，這種變化在近期疫情期間開始，但因工作環境的演變而持續。這些市場的變化會影響商業辦公室空間的需求，進而可能影響現有及未來商業不動產辦公室部門貸款的信用狀況、獲利能力與可收回性。如上文風險因素中關於信貸風險的風險因素所更詳細說明，波動與非 Performing 貸款增加可能會對 ACNB 的財務狀況與營運成果造成不利影響。
ACNB 的信貸損失準備金可能不足。
